content: We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no direct info about the molecule. We can get carbon NMR spectra which will show signals; aromatic carbons appear in ~110-160 ppm region. Could count distinct aromatic carbon signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That will give list of chemical shifts. Then count those in aromatic range. Use retrieve_carbon_shifts to know typical ranges for aromatic carbons. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
